concepts.gloss_en: Boaz (biblical figure, husband of Ruth; here the aspect of the redeemer/go'el)

reason_for_human: The vocalization בֹּעַז and the full paragraph make this unambiguous: it is the proper name Boaz (Boaz and Ruth = juxtaposing redemption to prayer; 'Boaz is the aspect of redeemer'). Round-1 wrongly floated a ב+עז clitic reading, but there is no such parsing here. Relabeled to the biblical figure Boaz.
